 Mega Millions jackpot climbs to $529 million for tonight’s drawing 
 November 10, 2026 
 Posted by NC Lottery at 
 11:53 AM 
 Tweet 
 The Mega Millions jackpot continues to grow as it reached $529 million for Tuesday’s drawing.
 A winner tonight would have the choice of taking home the $529 million jackpot as an annuity or $224.2 million in cash.
 Even though the jackpot remains up for grabs, players are taking home lots of other prizes playing Mega Millions. Friday’s drawing produced more than 8,000 winning tickets in North Carolina.
 The odds of winning a Mega Millions jackpot are 1 in 290 million.
 Players can buy Mega Millions tickets at any lottery retail location or through Online Play on the lottery’s website, www.nclottery.com, or with the NC Lottery Official Mobile App.

 Lol, Mega Millions will have to keep rigging their overpriced game to keep their jackpot high in order to get more unsuspecting players involved. They've lost a lot of players as a result of their greedy decision to escalate their price from $2 per set of draw numbers to $5 per draw! It is a complete snub to hard working folks who only want to dream. Shame to these national lotteries and the government departments allowing large scale corruption to rot our society.
